description: Implementation of FeatureOptInService class managing feature opt-in logic, including resolving feature states, listing features, and permission checks within a feature flag system.

classes.name: FeatureOptInService
classes.description: Service class for managing feature opt-in logic, including resolving feature states, listing features, and permission checks.

methods.name: teamFeatureToState
methods.description: Converts TeamFeaturesDto object to FeatureState string ('inherit', 'enabled', 'disabled').

methods.name: userFeatureToState
methods.description: Converts UserFeaturesDto object to FeatureState string ('inherit', 'enabled', 'disabled').

methods.name: resolveFeatureStatesAcrossTeams
methods.description: Resolves feature states for a user across all their teams, considering org and global settings.

methods.name: resolveFeatureState
methods.description: Determines the effective state of a specific feature for a user, considering all levels and auto-opt-in rules.

methods.name: resolveFeatureStates
methods.description: Resolves feature states for a list of features for a user.

methods.name: listFeaturesForUser
methods.description: Lists all opt-in features with their states for a user, scoped to 'user' and 'settings'.

methods.name: listFeaturesForTeam
methods.description: Lists all opt-in features with their raw states for a team or organization, including org state if applicable.

methods.name: checkFeatureOptInEligibility
methods.description: Checks if a user is eligible to see the feature opt-in banner, considering feature status and user permissions.

methods.name: getUserOrgAndTeamIds
methods.description: Retrieves the organization ID and team IDs associated with a user.

methods.name: getUserRoleContext
methods.description: Determines the user's role context (org admin, team admin) for permission checks.

methods.name: setUserFeatureState
methods.description: Sets the feature state for a user, either enabling, disabling, or inheriting.

methods.name: setTeamFeatureState
methods.description: Sets the feature state for a team, either enabling, disabling, or inheriting.
